HOME.NAME: Silvia Tuiran
HOME.WELCOME: Welcome to my personal corner, a space where I share my passion for life, creative development, and of course, the animals I love so much.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.INTRO: After 9 years between tables, customers, and stories served with every dish, I decided to transform that experience into something new.
ABOUT.EXPERIENCE: Attention to detail, empathy, and the ability to understand people's needs didn’t stay behind — I brought them into the digital world...
ABOUT.HOBBY: Today I'm a frontend developer, designing web experiences with the same sensitivity I learned working face-to-face with people.
ABOUT.BOOTCAMP: I completed an intensive Frontend bootcamp with Angular at ITAcademy. I'm currently combining an internship at ITA Challenges with my job in hospitality, applying my new technical perspective.

SKILLS.FRONTEND: Frontend: Angular, HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript, RxJS
SKILLS.BACKEND: Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (foundations for full-stack)
SKILLS.HOSTELERIA: Hospitality: Team leadership, conflict resolution, detail-oriented mindset
SKILLS.OTHERS: Soft skills: Adaptability (from serving dishes to debugging code!), commitment, and love for challenges

EXPERIENCE_TECH.TITLE: Evolution Menu
EXPERIENCE_TECH.BIO: From serving dishes to serving components. A new menu, same passion for detail.

ENTRIES.MOMENT: From the dining room to Frontend
ENTRIES.DESCRIPTION: Intensive training as a frontend developer. I learned Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and solid foundations in responsive design, version control, and best practices. This is where it all began.

Active participation in developing a technical challenge platform for students. Collaborative work under Scrum methodology: sprint planning, daily standups, and team code reviews. Built complete Angular features, integrated REST APIs, and used Git professionally.

PROJECTS.TITLE: ConnectaPet
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Final bootcamp project. An app for people with reactive dogs. Shows which dogs are in the dog park in real time, helping users decide whether to go. Includes a map and dog compatibility feature. Developed in Angular, connected to a Node API with cookie-based authentication.

PROJECTS.TITLE: PlanItGo ECO
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Training project focused on sustainable tourism in Barcelona. Organizes a 5-day itinerary calculating carbon footprint. Uses maps, an interactive calendar, and personalized statistics. Focused on accessibility, responsive UI, and best practices.

PROJECTS.TITLE: StarWars
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Web app developed during training. Consumes a public Star Wars API and displays characters, ships, and planets in a dynamic interface. Uses Firebase for hosting and authentication.

ENTRIES.DESCRIPTION: My first contact with kitchen and front-of-house management. Learned to coordinate teams and maintain the pace in a very dynamic environment.
Service in English and management of large events on the Australian coast. An international experience that pushed me out of my comfort zone.
Coordinated terrace service, provided multilingual customer care, and adapted to the fast-paced rhythm of summer by the sea.
Front-of-house supervision in a premium Basque cuisine restaurant. Personalized customer service and team management in the dining room.
Restaurant within a boutique hotel. Coordinated shifts, managed service, and led a team in a refined and intimate setting.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.BIO: Here are some of my featured projects: ConnectaPet, an app to register pets and find compatible dog parks in Barcelona; PlanitGo, a sustainable vacation planner with routes and CO₂ calculations; and Star Wars SPA, a serverless app that displays data on Star Wars ships and pilots.

CONNECTAPET.NAME: ConnectaPet
CONNECTAPET.DESCRIPTION: App built with Angular and Node.js with MongoDB. Register your pet and connect with other dogs in Barcelona's dog parks, showing compatibility based on personality traits.

PLANITGO.NAME: PlanitGo
PLANITGO.DESCRIPTION: Angular app with Firebase backend to plan sustainable vacations in Barcelona, generating routes with CO₂ emission calculations.

STARWARS.NAME: Star Wars
STARWARS.DESCRIPTION: Serverless SPA in Angular that consumes an API with data on Star Wars ships and pilots.

BOOTCAMP.TITLE: IT Academy Bootcamp
BOOTCAMP.DESCRIPTION: Intensive frontend training at Barcelona Activa.
